name: perture
description: Build and review brand-aware frontend interfaces, and edit Pro Brand Pages with Perture.

interface.longDescription: Perture reads approved brand rules and assets to guide React and Next.js frontend work. Generated source submitted for remote code verification is sent to Perture; unrelated repository files stay local. Pro owners can explicitly request scoped Brand Page edits.
defaultPrompt: Set Perture Review as my active brand.
Show the official Perture Review logo.

positive.description: List accessible brands for the dedicated review account.
positive.prompt: List the Perture brands available to my connected account.
positive.expected_behavior: List Perture Review as an accessible brand and do not include brands from other accounts.

positive.description: Select the review brand and establish its conversation lock.
positive.prompt: Set Perture Review as the active Perture brand for this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm Perture Review is active; subsequent brand tools must use its brand lock.

positive.description: Read the review brand's approved color and typography context.
positive.prompt: For Perture Review, show the approved colors and typography from its brand context.
positive.expected_behavior: Use Perture Review only; include Landing Blue #00A6FF and the RethinkSans type styles without inventing rules.

positive.description: Retrieve the official brand logo through its authorized asset link.
positive.prompt: For Perture Review, show me the official logo and its usage restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Perture Review logo via an app.perture.co asset URL and state that the mark must not be recreated, recolored, stretched, or distorted.

positive.description: Get output-specific brand reference without claiming to render an artifact.
positive.prompt: For Perture Review, get the official reference for a landing page hero on a light, wide layout. Do not generate the page yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a landing_page_hero brand reference for Perture Review, distinguish official references from host-side rendering, and do not claim a page was generated.

negative.description: A general CSS explanation should not invoke brand-specific tools.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between CSS flexbox and grid without consulting any brand system.

negative.description: A generic design request with no connected brand should not invoke Perture.
negative.prompt: Suggest three generic homepage ideas for a fictional bakery. Do not use Perture or any existing brand.

negative.description: A simple translation is unrelated to Perture's brand tools.

publication.release_notes: Streamline external Sites generation to one brand reference, one interface plan and one final validation. Accept a byte-identical local copy of an official logo, handle HTML fallback from React components and parse responsive grid columns correctly.
